subject: Game Theory
title: What Is the Prisoner's Dilemma?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is the Prisoner's Dilemma?.

hook.text: Two suspects sit in separate rooms. Each must choose: stay silent or betray. Neither knows the other's choice.

buildup.text: If both stay silent, both get light sentences. If one betrays while the other doesn't, the betrayer goes free.

discovery.text: But if both betray, both get harsh sentences. The 'rational' choice—betray—makes everyone worse off.

twist.text: This isn't about crime. It models any situation where self-interest clashes with mutual benefit.

climax.text: Nuclear arms races, price wars, and climate talks all follow the prisoner's dilemma pattern.

punchline.text: Rationality can be its own trap.

quiz.question: What happens when both prisoners betray each other?
